values./system/biography: A lightly built Protectron security drone deployed in the Skull Canyon complex.
values./items/@e9d35d909f81b0ad/system/descript: Body + Guns (TN 7), Burst, Piercing 1, Range C, Fire Rate 4.
values./items/@245faaf0c91635a1/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@4fefd6743d3d7345/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@05d3da1471450a7b/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@ff1eacc80410ac97/system/descript: Each injured arm reduces Fire Rate by 2; both injured arms disable the attack.
values./items/@2d197858236c4bfa/system/descript: Once per combat add Fire Rate to Arm Lasers damage without ammunition.
values./items/@8e5a0b3d326cc54f/system/descript: At half HP or with both arms injured, move to the nearest enemy and self-destruct.
